subject: How to deal with the metal center contain a phosphorylated amino acid by MCPB.py

messages.author: 吕思凡
messages.body:
Hi,
I’m trying to build a complex contain metal MG, ligand, a phosphorylated amino acid. The phosphorylated amino acid require binding to MG.
but I don’t know how to deal with the phosphorylated amino acid from this tutorial MCPB.py(
https://ambermd.org/tutorials/advanced/tutorial20/mcpbpy.php
).
I need to prepare mol2 file and frcmod file for the phosphorylated amino acid, and to set the MCPB.in file such tutorial 1OKL.in.
Please help me to solve this problem.
Best,
Sifan lyu
AlloStar Platform, Nutshell Therapeutics

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Jul 06, 2023, 吕思凡 via AMBER wrote:
>
>I need to prepare mol2 file and frcmod file for the phosphorylated amino
>acid, and to set the MCPB.in file such tutorial 1OKL.in.
Note that many phosphorylated amino acid units are already available: See
section 3.7 in the Reference Manual: "Modified amino acids and nucleotides".
Even if what you want isn't present, you could see how the phosphates were
added, and work by analogy to your situation.
....dac
